'''Brandon Allen Why Brandon Allen is #817 in the world''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Brandon Allen]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-7483">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7483 Why Brandon Allen is #817 in the world], DeckTech (Brandon "Sundevil" Allen, 12 June 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/7483/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/7483/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018162324/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7483/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Brandon Allen]]
* '''Published:''' 12 June 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Why Brandon Allen is #817 in the world''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star|ANH-D-deathstar.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 DeathStar Allen DS 2000 7483.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' The deck title is a joke not bragging. (is 817 worth bragging about? answer: no)

== Original post ==

'''Why Brandon Allen is #817 in the world'''
* '''Author:''' Brandon "Sundevil" Allen
* '''Published:''' June 12, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' The deck title is a joke not bragging. (is 817 worth bragging about? answer: no)

=== Strategy ===

Hidden Base This is easy...Probe and Battle.

==== Profit ====

Get Imp. Decree of fast and drain like hell

==== MWYHL ====

Drain like hell

Everything Else Drain like hell

IAO is in there for all the unique imps with abilty <3. But you all know the drill.
